description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa TransUnion (TLOxp). Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Fungua https://service.transunion.com/dss/ccpa_optout.page and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. The site asks for a Social Security or driver's license number, which OpenOptOut never fills in; only finish it if you're comfortable sharing that with them. Use {contact_email} if it asks for an email address. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
